title: Club 57: Film, Performance, and Art in the East Village, 1978–1983

description.main: Catalogue of the Museum of Modern Art's 2017-18 exhibition on Club 57, the East Village venue for film, performance and art.
description.extended:
The catalogue of the Museum of Modern Art's 2017-18 exhibition on Club 57, the East Village venue that mixed film, performance, art and fashion between 1978 and 1983.

Club 57 occupied the basement of a Polish church at 57 St. Marks Place and began as a no-budget space for music and film. The book follows its programming through film, video, performance, painting, zines and fashion, with essays by Ron Magliozzi, Sophie Cavoulacos, J. Hoberman, Jenny Schlenzka, Laura Hoptman, Lucy Gallun and Ann Magnuson, plus a chronology and a film and videography. The exhibition ran from October 31, 2017 to April 1, 2018.

The club's early curatorial staff included film programmers Susan Hannaford and Tom Scully, Keith Haring as exhibition organizer, and Ann Magnuson for performance. Ron Magliozzi (b. 1949) and Sophie Cavoulacos edited the volume, with a foreword by Glenn Lowry.
